{{Quote|Bey.|Kajin Savaros’s mother whispering Kajin’s fathers name at the sight of the Inquisitor.|<ref name="CN3" />}}
An '''Inquisitor''' during the first year of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had, with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]], raided the world of [[M'haeli/Legends|M’haeli]]. They were the only [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] in the raid. This was the first Inquisitor [[Kajin Savaros]] ever saw. He had been leaving the trading post in the village of [[Imrai]] after bartering some of their fruit crop for machinery, when his mother spotted a disturbance at the fringes of the village, clutched Kaj’s arm and whispered Kaj’s fathers name, [[Bey Savaros|Bey]], having spotted the Inquisitor. The terror in his mothers voice had chilled Kajin. The [[Parent/Legends|parents]] exchanged glances, The mother terrified and Bey initially filled with rage but his look quickly dimmed to despair. Kajin remembered the sighting vividly.<ref name="CN3" />
